audit_name: EOS Core Step 9 Negative Security Suite & Adversarial Resilience Audit

findings.title: SynthesisEngine lacked explicit direct epistemic state mutation guard method
findings.attack_path: Caller attempting to invoke direct epistemic state assignment on SynthesisEngine without going through EvidenceEngine
findings.impact: Potential privilege escalation where SynthesisEngine could bypass EvidenceEngine state assignment
findings.fix: Implemented assignEpistemicStateDirectly guard method throwing AUTHORITY_VIOLATION

findings.title: ExecutionOrchestrator target path boundary permitted escaping workspace into arbitrary drive locations
findings.attack_path: ExecutionTask specifying C:\Ext or C:\Windows\System32 as target workspace path
findings.impact: Potential workspace escape into system directories during task execution
findings.fix: Hardened ingestTask to strictly reject targets escaping user's Documents workspace or targeting EOS Core root

remediations.description: Added assignEpistemicStateDirectly guard method preventing direct epistemic promotion
Hardened path normalization and workspace boundary checks in ingestTask
